findings.text: Independent Opus review pass_with_notes, 0 blocking: all 5 ACs reproduced over the reviewer's own temp repo+claims trees (cross-plan build frontier, dependency/decision gating, standalone + review surfacing, claimed exclusion, capability-subset + plan/label scoping); both non-tautology teeth (ignore capability_ok, ignore claimed_units) turn the selftest red; genuinely reuses plan.py + claim.py; stdlib, read-only (byte-identical repo+claims snapshots).

Closed the review's one flagged gap pre-ship: BUILD work now comes only from ACTIVE plans (ready/in_progress), so a draft (unapproved) plan's ready spec is no longer claimable (added a selftest for it). Non-blocking notes left as-is: a contract-violating bare-string requires degrades but fails CLOSED (validate.py rejects it); a spec listed in two plans is deduped first-plan-wins; a REVIEW unit's claim keys on spec id (Y3 integration).

summary: Y2 (WARP-0702, the global claimable frontier) is correct and honest. Independent adversarial review pass_with_notes, 0 blocking; gate GREEN (selftest 1001). claimable() computes build work across every active plan (draft plans excluded, closed pre-ship) plus standalone ready specs plus pending reviews, and filters out already-claimed, capability-mismatched, and out-of-scope work; it reuses the pure plan logic and the claim ledger rather than reimplementing, is read-only, and both non-tautology teeth are caught. proof_digest via validate.py.
